entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-08-28
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • JsonException: '0x00' is an invalid start of a value. #50529
  • File-based apps are not packed/published in Release config by default like their project-based counterparts #50528
    10.0.1xx
  • MaxParallelTestModulesOption should be int, not string #50526
  • [NETSDKE2E][Regression]The hotkeys for "Ok" and "Cancel" don't display on "File in Use" dialog #50523
  • [NETSDKE2E][Regression]The hotkeys don't work on "File in Use" dialog #50522
  • [NETSDKE2E][Regression]After the installation is successfully canceled, the C drive still shows the dotnet directory #50521

Closed

  • WASI SDK not found in .net 10 #50536
  • [BrowserRefresh] Handle the case where the document is already pre-compressed #50451
  • Test templates: Don't add TestingPlatformDotnetTestSupport if user specifies MTP in dotnet.config #48031
  • VSTest package reference shouldn't be there when using MSTest metapackage #46887

PullRequests

Created

  • [release/10.0.1xx] [BrowserRefresh] Handle gzip-compressed responses in ResponseStreamWrapper #50535
    Servicing-consider
  • Port Hot Reload changes from main #50534
    Area-AspNetCore
  • Remove NETStandard.Library.Ref from Version.Details.xml/.props #50533
    Area-CodeFlow
  • [10.0.1xx] Disable static graph restore for file-based apps #50532
    Area-run-file
  • [10.0.1xx] Consolidate default verbosity of msbuild-based commands #50531
    Area-run-file
  • Support `-getProperty` and friends with file-based apps #50530
    Area-run-file
  • Handle --minimum-expected-tests #50527
    Area-dotnet test (MTP)
  • Clean up duplicate options in dotnet test #50524
    Area-dotnet test (MTP)
  • [release/10.0.1xx] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #50518

Merged

  • [BrowserRefresh] Handle gzip-compressed responses in ResponseStreamWrapper #50452
  • Fix VB test templates to remove namespace duplication in Test Explorer #50525
  • Remove unnecessary license and xml headers #49963
    Area-Infrastructure
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0.1xx' => 'main' #50509
  • Localized file check-in by OneLocBuild Task: Build definition ID 140: Build ID 2780955 #50510
  • [release/10.0.1xx] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #50427

Updated

    Area-AspNetCore

    Branch Lockdown

    Area-Infrastructure, Area-Common templates

    Area-dotnet test (MTP)

    Area-dotnet test (MTP)
